independent_derivations: Density in U intersect V equals density in X for open witnesses because U intersect V is dense open in X. Reflexivity and symmetry are immediate; transitivity intersects dense equality witnesses.

For restriction to an open U use representatives on V and W and a dense equality witness T inside V intersect W. The restricted maps agree on U intersect T, which is dense open in U, including the empty-open case.

For each dense open U of X the fibre-product universal property bijects S-morphisms U to Y with sections over U of X times_S Y over X. Pair each morphism with the inclusion U to X. This natural bijection commutes with restriction and therefore descends to rational classes.

Maps U to affine one-space over the integers naturally represent sections of O_U. Base change gives the equivalent X-section formulation. Taking equivalence classes over all dense opens preserves this bijection without finite-component assumptions.
Add and multiply representatives after restriction to their common dense open. Restriction is a ring homomorphism; common refinement proves independence of representatives and all ring laws.
